notes.title: Early Access transition
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44385665/849df513771248d9595c72168475f544d5953252.png[/img]


Hello everyone, 


Today's update marks the completion of [b]Match it Sexy[/b] and it's transition from Early Access to Completed. 

We would like to thank you for your support, it really meant a lot for us!
With your help and support we have been able to properly test the game and fix all the bugs reported, with your feedback we have been able to add improvements to the game, like sex SFX, match slides, mechanics balancing, etc. This is why Early Access is such a great opportunity for most dev's and why your support is so important. 


Unfortunately, there is one bug we haven't been able to completely squash, and it means that when you will update the game, you will loose all the passive upgrades that you already bought. This doesn't affect your existing completed dates, but it does mean you will need to start farming those passives again. 
We have tried to find a solution that would have allowed us to retrieve your stats from a previous save, but we couldn't find a good way of doing it. 


With your continued support we have been able to add an extra character, as we initially planed the game with only 3 girls, taking the game to 4 girls, each with 3 dates. Now, the game consists of over 250 animations and over 600 renders. 


All that being said, please check out our other games, some of them coming out really soon, like [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2650630/Last_Hope/]Last Hope[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2774580/Vikings_Sex_and_Blood/]Vikings: Sex and Blood[/url].
